summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @newspage/libx-amount phones home on module load
details: The package is a placeholder whose index.js, on require/import, issues an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net at path /libx. The scoped name `@newspage/libx-amount`, the implausibly high 99.99.41 version, the `A simple placeholder for npm.` description, and the anonymous author together form the canonical dependency-confusion shape intended to shadow an internal `@newspage`-scoped package during resolution. The beacon's purpose is to confirm successful resolution of the squatted name inside a target organization, disclosing the installer's source IP and the fact that the internal namespace resolved to this external artifact. The package provides no other functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
